verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a programmable API: personal API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses, an API-endpoints reference exists, and a gateway exposes workspaces as OpenAI-compatible models. However, the reference is declared experimental, the Swagger docs only appear on a self-hosted instance running with ENV=dev, no published OpenAPI spec was found (probes returned 404), and no REST deprecation window is promised. missing for 10: a stable, non-experimental public API reference; a published, downloadable OpenAPI spec or hosted playground; a REST-specific versioning or deprecation policy; independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: An API key is a personal access token that lets external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses.
Access detailed API documentation for different services provided by Open WebUI
Make sure to set the `ENV` environment variable to `dev` in order to access the Swagger documentation
The gateway exposes each of your workspaces as an OpenAI-compatible model, so any OpenAI-style client can run agent tasks in a real workspace.
